R7D.label: all pre-event endoscopies

sample_unit.note: each sample takes its endoscopy's call; (H) and S-LATE at the binary threshold reaching V0's per-repeat endoscopy sensitivity

same_block.note: labels from the round-7 lookup Q1 (case number + block on the sheet's Path ID vs the slide's PathCaseID + Block; clinical_lookup/q6_q1fix.py logic); 'not same block' = different block, block not recorded on one side, or case unparseable

R7D.note: endoscopy = (patient, endoscopy number) over the pre-event samples; V0 thresholds per (repeat, fold) from the training endoscopies' inner out-of-fold L-IMG (score, top sample, cleared) and L-CNV / L-LATE (confirmation); single model (per-repeat values averaged over the 10 repeats); comparators evaluation-matched: specificity read at the rule's per-repeat endoscopy sensitivity on the pooled (across folds) empirical ROC with linear interpolation; patient bootstrap 2,000 draws (RandomState(0)); rederived = every threshold re-derived from the resampled training patients' inner predictions in each draw (primary interval); fixed = thresholds and calls fixed (rounds 4-7)
